update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.35 - Train through low mood at high energy
Added ----- - Train Through Low Mood at High Energy (Training Settings, off by default): when energy is at or above a threshold (default 80%), the mood-recovery threshold is relaxed by one level, so the bot trains through a small mood dip (e.g. Normal mood) instead of spending the turn on a recreation outing. A run with energy to spare can afford to train through a slightly lower mood, since mood is a training-gain multiplier rather than a hard gate. At low energy, mood recovery works exactly as before.
